description: This is a utility class named 'Utils' used in both handset and wearable apps within the package 'com.example.android.wearable.speedtracker.common'. It provides a method to generate a simple hash for a day based on the year and day of year from a Calendar object.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for common functions, currently includes a method for hashing a day.

methods.name: getHashedDay
methods.description: Generates a hash string for a given Calendar date based on year and day of year.
